name: Orchestra
description: See and steer Orca orchestration runs on this computer or a saved server: a live task DAG, workers and decisions, with every write previewed before it is sent.

cover.alt: Orchestra: a framed view of the live task DAG on a calm neutral background

screenshots.alt: The Orchestra panel in the Orca light theme, showing a run's live task DAG, six tasks and one pending decision
screenshots.caption: Live DAG, dependencies and task state, refreshed every three seconds

screenshots.alt: The same Orchestra run in the Orca dark theme
screenshots.caption: The same run in the dark theme

screenshots.alt: The Orchestra panel with the Host selector set to a saved remote server
screenshots.caption: Switch the Host selector to any saved Orca server

screenshots.alt: A confirm dialog previewing a new task, with its exact target and parameters
screenshots.caption: Every write is previewed with its exact target before it is sent

screenshots.alt: The task board, with columns for waiting on dependencies, ready, in progress and finished tasks, plus dependency links and the dispatch terminal
screenshots.caption: Tasks, dependencies and dispatches in one board
